name: Inori
source:
“How do you think I learned all this stuff?! Money see, monkey do!”

Whenever there’s monkey business afoot, it’s a safe bet that Inori is involved. Her rebellious spirit is matched only by a compulsive love of technology.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1483061751621029889?s=20&t=bV6EA0oyHTTLY9Z7B6cGHw]official Twitter[/url]]
